verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules v2 explicitly support controlling merchant categories (MCC) and can be applied at program/account/card level, with shadow-mode testing before enforcement (lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-4, lithic-docs-11). However, the evidence never explicitly describes an MCC allowlist/blocklist distinction or a single-merchant lock feature. missing for 10: explicit allowlist vs blocklist configuration semantics, single-merchant lock capability, and independent confirmation these apply strictly at authorization time.
